name: Sola
source:
The only survivor against the last invasion of "evil" caused by Witch Malvirtulo. She defeated her opponent valiantly by absorbing the powers of her fallen comrades.
Ten years later, the people of Urbo asked Sola to train the new generation of Magical Girls, which she agreed to do.
